dos.text: Rely on moz-page-nav.mjs's own hasSecondaryNav check to get the separator, it renders a real <hr> between the primary-nav-group and secondary-nav-group automatically once a secondary nav exists.

donts.text: Don't author this <hr> yourself or give it a class, moz-page-nav.mjs places it directly in its own render() output with no dedicated sub-component.
